why: LAP — take 1 doan 'hoat huyet thuc cho mau chay manh hon' bi hut (chi toi 'dong can giay'). Take 2 tu 41.1s noi lai day du, ro hon ('hai thu khien mach mau minh hep lai') va noi tiep sang doan bom nuoc. Giu take sau.
LAP — 'Neu voi nhung nguoi ma dang gap... vi du nhu la' bo lung. Take sau tu 71.76 noi tron y: 'Neu voi nhung nguoi ma cai ong nuoc cua ho co nhung mang xo vua lau'.
LAP — 'Day chinh la' hut giua chung. Giu take sau: 'Day la xu ly cai nguyen nhan lam Fibrin de dan lai'.
'Thi' lo dang + 2.18s im lang. Bo cho lien mach: '...hoac sap phau thuat / hay hoi bac si truoc'.
LAP — 'De anh chi hieu' lan 1 bo lung roi ngung. Giu lan 2 (274.52) vi no noi tron: 'De anh chi hieu dieu kien minh can dung'.
Duoi bai: sau chu 'benh' cua disclaimer chi con im lang, whisper ao giac them 'Hay subscribe cho kenh La La School'. Cat den het.
